Review date: 2026-10-08. Scope: complete captured issue body and all 12 comments, current private ticket ownership, October 7 and October 8 discovery candidates, and bounded primary-source precedent. This is a read-only coverage audit, not full design verification, implementation verification, deployment approval, or a new ticket disposition. No critic or lead synthesis was read.

The discussion is substantially captured by topic, but the candidate's Issue 31 source cutoff is outdated. The October 8 comment reports a materially different native tool-step executor and permission route. Native metadata fidelity already has a qualification home; the new route needs an explicit compatibility delta before export can claim that the discussion is fully current. Warm optimization, platform dependency selection, and golden replay evidence have general owners but lack source-specific disposition. ## Novelty and reuse assessment

Do not present tool Activities, deferred hooks, stable tool-use IDs, approvals, Workflow-owned conversation, Continue-As-New, External Storage, live output, golden replay, cold workspace snapshots, native bounded replay, or warm process reuse as inventions of this candidate. They are described or implemented in the captured public work and linked sources. A public comment about work “built locally” is a different evidence class from accessible pinned source and passing runtime artifacts.

The [hybrid prototype native_replay.py](https://github.com/temporalio/ai-integrations/blob/2ab873cc23a1b3224531a5634c1f6d1c8ef0ea1f/python/claude_agent_sdk/tests/hybrid/native_replay.py) contains the bounded stand-in response, exact ID/name/input check, one-turn cap and isolated transcript mirror (`execute`, lines221 onward). Its native workspace tests require the sibling experimental SDK. This is source precedent for bounded native replay and version-dependent recovery, not proof that the October 8 port is already in PR33 or that arbitrary workspace snapshots are host-loss safe.

The [SDK recovery fork README](https://github.com/brianstrauch/claude-agent-sdk-python/blob/3ac4b25733d1302c89d0dadd13cab268e64d1213/README.md#main-agent-recovery-with-a-session-store) explicitly assigns durable callback IDs/idempotency and exclusive ownership/fencing to the host; conditional append is required, but the SDK supplies neither a lease nor exactly-once external effects. Main-agent scope excludes active subagent restoration/custom transports. Existing local `_runner.py` enforces recovery API/store capability and rejects recovery attempt other than one or fork; `_workflow.py` still refuses governed execution with PolicyExecutorUnavailable until an executor exists. These boundaries support integration reuse, not a replacement agent loop.

The [pinned harness README](https://github.com/temporal-community/temporal-agent-harness/blob/f50412138cab078f19c54e683e7ba5e529323f17/README.md) provides durable session/tool/subagent and virtual-filesystem prior art. Its ActivityFileSystem section distinguishes replayed tree/index from current backing-store contents (lines569 through576). It is not a demonstrated substitute for exact Claude native state restoration.

Temporal Docs support the [Entity Workflow](https://docs.temporal.io/design-patterns/entity-workflow), [Continue-As-New](https://docs.temporal.io/design-patterns/continue-as-new), and [Update request-response](https://docs.temporal.io/design-patterns/request-response-via-updates#best-practices) building blocks. Update deduplication is scoped to one Run; handover requires retained application state. The proposed independently retained effect authority plus accepted trajectory/workspace manifest plus physical old-execution termination is **partial precedent applied to a new composition**, not a sanctioned complete recipe found in this search. Retry documentation supports reuse of recorded completed Activity outcomes and reexecution of failed attempts, not transactional arbitrary external effects.

The useful distinction is a proposed qualification protocol: accepted orchestration and exact native trajectory, complete workspace restoration, independently retained intent outside snapshot rollback, and authoritative old execution termination before replacement. No complete implementation of that combined promise was found in this bounded search. That supports “unimplemented composition of existing mechanisms requiring qualification”; it does not support “novel invention,” “first,” or “no other solution exists.”

## Limitations and disposition

No current candidate mechanism was executed. Retained demonstrations remain bounded by recorded source/dependency/runtime/topology and approved exceptions; DONE is not a universal runtime success label. No model/provider, platform install, storage failover, permission reproducer, native replay port, or CI rerun was authorized or performed. Source search was bounded, and the exact new native port commit was not available at current PR33 head. Docs calls ground Temporal primitives, not the Claude engine's closed-source semantics.

Before exporting a claim of complete discussion coverage, add the latest source and precise owner notes above, or explicitly disclose that coverage ends at6043344791 and list6065563646 as an unincorporated compatibility delta. Technical thematic coverage is strong; source currency and selected-route compatibility remain conditional. Public collaborator suggestions and permission to port work do not decide the operator's BD choices, amend approved v1 scope, close tickets, or authorize this session to implement.
